experienceContent.overview: I build web applications across the frontend, backend and cloud infrastructure. My experience includes enterprise systems, digital media, marketplaces and commerce, with a focus on reusable architecture, reliable delivery and production stability.

cards.title: Enterprise applications & shared platforms
highlights: Built functionality for remote device management and operational workflows, including granular role-based access control and shared React/MUI components used across applications.
Reduced redundant API calls, introduced parallel backend execution, optimized Redis scans and designed Azure Durable Functions workflows for maintenance and deployments.

cards.title: Serverless systems & cloud modernization
highlights: Led and automated a JavaScript-to-TypeScript migration across 36 repositories and more than 150 AWS Lambda functions, alongside AWS SDK v3 modernization.
Built GraphQL services and infrastructure as code, standardized shared models and persistence through NPM packages, and maintained production monitoring, alerts and CI/CD workflows.

cards.title: AI-assisted marketplace
highlights: Owned delivery across frontend, backend, data, cloud deployment and production support; migrated the frontend to Next.js for server-side rendering and technical SEO.
Integrated AI-generated product descriptions and content validation, and built unified search across products, events and users.

cards.title: Multi-market e-commerce
highlights: Maintained Magento Enterprise storefronts across 22 countries, building responsive templates and shared storefront functionality.
Developed mobile navigation and collaborated with designers on consistent, localized customer experiences.

cards.title: Hospitality applications
highlights: Developed React and Material UI applications for customer-facing, kitchen and back-office workflows.
Implemented English, German, French and Italian localization, integrated Stripe payments and collaborated with clients on product improvements.

contributions.title: Public contributions
contributions.intro: Small tools that make everyday development feel a little smoother.

items.headline: See the icon, stay in the flow.
items.description: An icon name tells only half the story. MUI Icon Preview brings the actual shape into VS Code with SVG previews on hover and in completions. Search the installed icon catalog and insert an import and JSX usage without breaking your coding rhythm.
items.detail: Everything runs locally using the workspace’s @mui/icons-material package. No browser detour, no uploaded source code.

items.headline: A small check at the edge of every request.
items.description: HTTP headers carry the details that keep web communication working. This focused utility validates header names and values, giving developers a simple way to check them before passing them along.
items.detail: My contribution added TypeScript support, making this JavaScript utility easier to use in typed projects.

collaborationParagraphs: I am comfortable taking a project from an initial idea to a working product, connecting business goals with technical decisions and carrying the work through architecture, implementation, release and production support. I bring the independence to move things forward, the judgment to make trade-offs explicit and the accountability to stay involved beyond the first delivery.

I work effectively both independently and within small, focused teams, larger engineering organizations and environments where several teams contribute to the same product ecosystem. I adapt to the context: working hands-on across the stack, developing shared capabilities or coordinating dependencies with the people who build on them. My focus is on making individual contributions fit into a coherent, maintainable whole.

For me, collaboration means creating clarity around priorities, surfacing risks early and turning technical complexity into decisions people can act on. I work with product owners, designers, engineers and solution architects to shape practical implementation plans, share context and keep delivery aligned with the product’s needs. Through code reviews, mentoring, onboarding and clear documentation, I help knowledge travel across team boundaries and support continuity as the product evolves.

steps.title: Start with a conversation
steps.description: We talk through your idea, the problem behind it and what success would look like. I listen, ask questions and align expectations around budget, timing and how we will work together.

steps.title: Understand the people and context
steps.description: Who will use the product, and what do they need? Together, we explore their everyday challenges, your business goals and the market to give the project a clear purpose.

steps.title: Turn ideas into a clear plan
steps.description: I organize requirements, dependencies and risks into priorities and manageable milestones. We agree on what the first release needs and map out future features, leaving room to learn and adapt.

steps.title: Choose the right technical direction
steps.description: I shape the architecture and choose technologies that fit the product, the team and the budget. We consider growth, integrations, security and maintenance so the system can scale as demand grows.

steps.title: Build together, step by step
steps.description: I connect technical decisions with delivery, keeping progress and tradeoffs clear. Through regular demos, testing and honest conversations, we review what is working and adjust the plan together.

steps.title: Keep evolving after launch
steps.description: Release is the start of the next phase. I stay involved, listen to users and the client, and use feedback and production insights to guide ongoing improvements as market and business needs change.

homeContent.personalTitle: Away from the screen. Close to the people I love.
homeContent.personalDescription: Outside of work, time with family and friends comes first. I enjoy being together, catching up and sharing everyday moments. I also make room for movement: running, cycling, swimming, weight training, walks and time in nature.
homeContent.personalNoteTitle: Good company. Time to stay active.
homeContent.personalNote: Time with the people closest to me, a workout or a quiet walk — these are the things I like to make room for outside of work.
homeContent.overviewDetail: I work across enterprise applications, marketplaces, commerce and hospitality. Whether I am building a new product or improving an existing platform, I focus on how the pieces fit together, how teams can maintain them and how the system can evolve with the business.
